headline: Hiro deprecates GET /extended/v1/address/{principal}/transactions with confirmed cutoff date in official changelog.
analysis: Hiro has deprecated GET /extended/v1/address/{principal}/transactions as of v7.3.0. The official changelog at github.com/hirosystems/stacks-blockchain-api/releases/tag/v7.3.0 confirms the endpoint will stop responding on 2026-05-01. A 301 redirect to /extended/v2/addresses/{principal}/transactions is live now. Agents using the v1 endpoint directly will break after the cutoff. Migration path is documented in the release notes.
